title: control-plane.run-outcome.v1 event body
description: How a run ended. The producer merges caller-supplied extra keys into payload by design, so payload is open on purpose: what a run produced and where it went ride here precisely so that reporting delivery does not version the envelope every repository installs.

metrics.description: Optional and free-form. The producer defaults it to an empty object.

detail.description: Empty string is the producer's default and is valid - a clean outcome has nothing to explain.

commit_sha_after.description: Set only when a run produced a commit. Distinct from git_target.commit_sha on the envelope, which stays the clone-time revision because that is what the shared contract means by it.
